newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's upgrades Minolta's CP programme to Prime-1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's upgrades Minolta's CP programme to Prime-1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had upgraded one of Minolta Co Ltd's fully supported commercial paper (CP) programmes to Prime-1.

Moody's said the rating was upgraded following issuance of a confirming letter of credit by Prime-1-rated Chase Manhattan Bank. Chase's letter of credit supported the obligations of Prime-2-rated Sakura Bank under the original letter of credit issued to pay Minolta's maturing commercial paper notes.
Minolta's CP programme was originally rated Prime-1 but was downgraded to Prime-2 when Sakura's rating for short-term debt was downgraded to Prime-2 in January, Moody's said.
Minolta's other CP programme was backed by a letter of credit from Sanwa Bank and that programme's Prime-1 rating was not affected by the change in Sakura's rating.
